value.note: PS/2 relative pointer (dbus-rel), Mouse-Speed pref at slowest = dead-linear 0.478 px/unit -> cursor_scale 2.09; the daemon caps each PS/2 send at one packet (SH_REL_MAX_STEP) so a fast drag can't desync the guest. 1024x768 RGB:555/16 on Cirrus GD5446. Station QEMU /opt/qemu-rhapsody (i8259 lenient-cascade).

labctl.notes: labctl exec over a getty on COM1 (serial.sock; exec_kind serial_getty, user root, password in the gitignored <dir>/serial-exec.passwd). No network exec. PS/2 deltas mis-decode if the i8042 queue is flooded — the daemon paces; SH_REL_MAX_STEP caps each send at one packet. loadvm golden.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# rhapsody (slot 146) — Rhapsody 5.1 Developer Release 2 for Intel (Apple, 1998):
#   the Platinum Finder on the NeXT/Mach substrate. qemu-system-i386 from
#   /opt/qemu-rhapsody (kernel-hive fork + i8259 lenient-cascade patch, without
#   which the Mach kernel loses every IDE interrupt). TCG, pentium2, 64 MB, one
#   2 GB IDE disk, Cirrus GD5446 at 800x600x16, i82557b, PS/2 mouse (dbus-rel).
#   loadvm golden -S (the daemon resumes). DARK LAUNCH: listing=hidden until the
#   operator eyeballs it.

launcherParity.reason: tracked verbatim launcher is the deployed launcher. Joined the retronet web plane 2026-08-23: the netdev went user(slirp) -> tap rhaprn0 on vmbr-rn and the NIC went i82557b -> tulip (DEC 21143), because Apple's Intel82557 driver programs the chip in flexible mode and QEMU's eepro100 model never delivers a received frame (Ipkts stuck at 0). Both the -device change and mac= bind only on a COLD boot, so the golden was re-baked cold on this device set 2026-08-23 with OmniWeb 3.0 installed; docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-rhapsody.md

reset.fixture: Rhapsody 5.1 DR2 with OmniWeb 3.0 open on the 1996 Space Jam corpus page (retronet gateway :80 origin, no proxy) at 1024x768 RGB:555/16 (Cirrus GD5446) — the guest home window carrying the OmniWeb.app icon behind it, bookmarks panel at the left edge, disk/home/Applications icons on the right, Trash bottom right. loadvm golden -S, the daemon resumes.

network.note: retronet web plane: the Intel EtherExpress PRO/100B (i82557b, the adapter DR2's Configure.app was given at install) is a REAL bridged NIC on vmbr-rn via the persistent tap rhaprn0 (streamhost/stations/rhapsody/rn-tapnet.sh, called `up` from the launcher on every start), MAC RN_RHAPSODY_MAC, driver Intel82557NetworkDriver as en0. Addressed 10.99.0.22/24 with DNS 10.99.0.2 and NO default gateway - STATIC, not DHCP, because Rhapsody DR2 ships no DHCP client at all (only the BOOTP-era bpwhoami), so the reservation exists only to keep the address unique. The address lives in /etc/iftab, the resolver in NetInfo /locations/resolver, and the absent default route in /etc/hostconfig ROUTER=-NO-. Behind the fail-closed RHAPRN-IN guard chain it reaches ONLY the gateway CT 10.99.0.2, where the period browser reads the corpus on :80 seamlessly (wildcard DNS, no proxy configured); never labhost, the LAN, the gallery or the internet. docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-rhapsody.md
